runLimits.title: Run limits
runLimits.description: How much one run of “Read my sources” may read and keep, for every model. Leave a box empty to keep the built-in value.
runLimits.maxRunSourcesTip: The most files a single run reads. A source that covers a whole workspace or folder counts each of its files. This is also the most files one workspace source can cover.
runLimits.maxRecordsPerSourceTip: The most records one source gives: one sheet of a spreadsheet, or one table of an e-mail archive. Rows past this number are not read, and the run says the data is incomplete.
runLimits.maxRecordsPerRunTip: The most records one run keeps, all concepts together (for example messages + people + attachments). Above it, records are left out and the run reports it.
runLimits.maxValuesPerRunTip: The most filled-in fields one run keeps, all records together. A message with 15 filled fields counts as 15 values. Raise it together with Records per run.
runLimits.note: Higher limits let bigger sources be read but make runs longer and use more memory on the server. Changing a limit marks the models’ data as out of date, so the next run reads the sources again.

index.title: Embedding & passages
index.description: How each record is turned into a search card, and how long text fields are cut into passages that are searched to their end. Leave a box empty to keep the built-in value.
index.note: Changing these rebuilds the search indexes on the next search.
index.cardValueCharsTip: The most characters of one field value put on a record’s search card. Longer values are cut.
index.cardTextCharsTip: The most characters of a record’s whole search card, all fields together. At least the card value size.
index.longFieldCharsTip: A text field longer than this is also cut into passages, so its whole text can be found. At most the card value size.
index.passageTargetCharsTip: The size each passage aims for, in characters. Passages end at a sentence or a paragraph near this size.
index.passageMinCharsTip: A passage is not cut shorter than this, unless the text ends. Smaller than the passage size.
index.passageMaxCharsTip: A passage is never longer than this. Larger than the passage size.
index.passageOverlapCharsTip: Characters repeated at the start of the next passage, so a sentence cut in two is still found. Smaller than the smallest passage.
index.maxPassagesPerFieldTip: The most passages one field gives. Text past them is not searched.
index.maxPassagesPerRecordTip: The most passages one record gives, all fields together. At least the passages per field.
index.passageHeader: Name the concept, record and field above each passage
index.passageHeaderTip: Each passage starts with where it comes from, so a search for a customer’s name also finds the passages of its contracts.

search.title: Search
search.description: How a search over a model’s records runs: word matching and meaning matching are fused into one list. Leave a box empty to keep the built-in value.
search.note: Applies to the next search; no rebuild.
search.lexicalCandidatesTip: Records taken from word matching before the two lists are fused.
search.vectorCandidatesTip: Records taken from meaning (vector) matching before the two lists are fused.
search.minSimilarityTip: From 0 to 1. A record found only by meaning is kept when it is at least this close to the question.
search.rrfKTip: How the two lists are fused (k of reciprocal rank fusion). Higher values let records further down each list count more.
search.defaultLimitTip: Records returned by find_records when the agent does not ask for a number. At most the results limit.
search.maxLimitTip: The most records one search can return.
search.passagesPerRecordTip: Matching passages shown with each record found. 0 shows none.
search.excerptCharsTip: Characters of a passage shown around the matched words.
search.snippetCharsTip: Characters of a record’s card shown with each result.
search.maxQueryTermsTip: The most words of a question used for word matching. Words past them are ignored.
search.stopWordsTip: Common words (de, la, the, of…) are ignored in word matching, so they do not decide the results.
search.extraStopWordsTip: Words also ignored in word matching, for example your company name when it is in every document. Separate them with commas or spaces.

problems.range: A value is outside its range.
problems.longField: The long field size cannot be larger than the card value size.
problems.cardText: The card size must be at least the card value size.
problems.passageOrder: The smallest passage must be smaller than the passage size, and the passage size smaller than the largest passage.
problems.overlap: The overlap must be smaller than the smallest passage.
problems.passagesPerRecord: Passages per record must be at least passages per field.
problems.limit: Results by default cannot be more than the results limit.
problems.stopWords: At most {{max}} words, each of 1 to {{length}} characters.

field.title: Search index
field.passagesTip: Global: the field is cut into passages when it is longer than the long field size. Yes: always. No: only its start, on the record’s card, is searched.
field.note: Empty boxes use the global settings. Changing these rebuilds the search index on the next search.
